# Agent Python Tools

## File: microsoft_playwright-python/playwright/sync_api/_context_manager.py

Prompts

```
['create a PlaywrightContextManager to initialize a synchronous Playwright browser session with context management', 'enter the PlaywrightContextManager context to get a SyncPlaywright instance for browser automation', 'start a Playwright session using the start method to return a SyncPlaywright instance', 'exit the PlaywrightContextManager to stop the connection and clean up the event loop', 'test the PlaywrightContextManager class for proper context entry, exit, and resource cleanup', 'navigate a page to a URL and click a button element by selector', 'locate DOM elements by ARIA role and accessible name for interaction', 'send HTTP GET and POST requests with form data and retrieve JSON responses', 'capture a full-page PNG screenshot and save it to a file path', 'assert that a page has a title and a locator is visible on the page']
```

Usage

```
{'create_playwright_context': 'create a PlaywrightContextManager to initialize a synchronous Playwright browser session with context management', 'enter_playwright_context': 'enter the PlaywrightContextManager context to get a SyncPlaywright instance for browser automation', 'start_playwright_session': 'start a Playwright session using the start method to return a SyncPlaywright instance', 'exit_playwright_context': 'exit the PlaywrightContextManager to stop the connection and clean up the event loop', 'test_playwright_context_manager': 'test the PlaywrightContextManager class for proper context entry, exit, and resource cleanup'}
```
